Makarand Rele was an undergraduate visiting BSc student with the CCWJ from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Bombay in India. His work supports research on the physics of thermal plasmas at atmospheric pressure, with a focus on heat-transfer concepts relevant to welding. He is involved in research that improves understanding of how thermal plasma behavior influences welding processes.

Outside of academics, Makarand enjoys Formula 1, long drives, and reading fiction.

####### Prior Degrees

BSc (ongoing), Mechanical Engineering, IIT Bombay, India
